caption: The drawing depicts a full-length dress in shades of teal and light blue, featuring a voluminous skirt that extends outward from the waist. The bodice of the dress is fitted and includes long sleeves; there are additional bands of fabric forming short, layered oversleeves at the top of each arm. The neckline is high and rounded, and the front of the bodice is decorated with a central panel of intricate white lace detailing that extends vertically down the chest and slightly flares at the waist. The dress appears unadorned except for this central lace panel, and the shading on the skirt and sleeves suggests a lustrous, possibly satin fabric. There are no visible buttons, fasteners, or accessories in the drawing, and the background is a plain off-white color.
title: Lavender Taffeta Dress
